idListConvention: UTF-8 LF, one stable ID per line, final LF when nonempty
context: all accepted IDs sharing at least one exact nodeNames value with a changed ID; all UI rows also supplied by mandatory regression
repetitions: all accepted IDs whose Russian source value equals one of the changed IDs Russian source values
glossaryReferentsRule: union of all accepted source rows matching any family; spelling variants and inflections are explicit in the regex; this targets the affected age/kinship, body-part, alone/lonely, mushroom and earwax risks
runtimeBindings: changed or context IDs with protected format slots, tags, whole-exact text, literal substrings, line breaks or trailing whitespace, plus changed/context UI and ChecksDialogs IDs; actual game runtime not executed
mandatoryRegressionGroups: gender/kinship/address IDs from affected scenes and full kinship/child-age concept family
components: union of changed, context, repetitions, glossary-referents, runtime-bindings, mandatory-regressions; no unaccepted source candidates
